relationships.subject: AT-RvD1
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with AT-RvD1 reversed the increase in the levels of NLRP3, ASC, and Caspase-1 P10 induced by SNL surgery (Figure 4A).

relationships.subject: AT-RvD1
relationships.evidence_quote: Results of immunoblotting analysis showed that administration of AT-RvD1 resulted in a dose-dependent increase in the expression of LC3BII/LC3BI and Beclin1 in rat spinal cords (Figure 2A).

relationships.subject: Autophagy
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking the autophagic activity using 3-MA reversed the AT-RvD1-mediated NLRP3 inflammasome inhibition and amelioration of algesia.

relationships.subject: AT-RvD1
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal injection of AT-RvD1 decreased the SNL-induced expression of IL-18, IL-1β, and TNF-ɑ in a dose-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: AT-RvD1
relationships.evidence_quote: AT-RvD1 increased the PWT and PWL in a dose-dependent manner.

key_findings: AT-RvD1 attenuates SNL hyperalgesia and spinal NLRP3 inflammasome activation, restoring autophagy markers (LC3B-II/I, Beclin1, ATG5).
Autophagy inhibitors 3-MA/BafA1 reverse AT-RvD1 effects on NLRP3 and cytokines in TNF-α-stimulated microglia.
